faq_heading: Questions hospitals ask about appointment chatbots

faqs.q: How much does an AI chatbot for a hospital cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the number of sites, doctors and departments, the languages, the channels and the systems the chatbot connects to. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: Go-live depends on the number of sites, the integrations with your scheduling system and how quickly your teams approve the handover rules. Clara AI confirms a timeline after diagnosis, based on your actual material.

faqs.q: Which hospital systems can the chatbot connect to?
faqs.a: Typically your appointment or scheduling system, your CRM and email, so bookings and handovers appear where staff already work. Where a direct connection is not possible, we agree a workable alternative during diagnosis.

faqs.q: Do patients need to download an app?
faqs.a: No. Patients use WhatsApp, which they already have, or the chat on your website.

faqs.q: Can one chatbot serve several hospitals and clinics?
faqs.a: Yes. The same assistant can serve several sites, with each location's doctors, hours and accepted insurers set up separately. The details are confirmed during diagnosis.
